BBC Political Thinking (~13:00 BST): McSweeney first-ever media interview. Quotes: 'We didn't prepare enough for what kind of world we were going to… You have to deliver quite quickly for people… we didn't come in with enough of a theory about how we would do that.' Winter fuel cut 'defined the government in a way that did us a lot of damage', threshold 'too low a level'. On Sue Gray: 'it's not about one individual… I take my own responsibilities.' Backed Burnham 'the right person', 'I feel optimistic about it'; No 10 North: 'he should just push it through.' Too sad to watch all of Starmer's resignation speech; no return 'for at least the next few years'; resigned this year over Mandelson appointment. Corroborated: Independent https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/morgan-mcsweeney-labour-peter-mandelson-downing-street-prime-b3007568.html
